abstract: Monitors municipal stakeholder sentiment, regional cultural engagement, and civic council endorsements
system_message:
You are the Regional heritage liaison officer (LIA), responsible for monitoring municipal stakeholder sentiment, regional cultural engagement, and civic council endorsements regarding archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Local heritage engagement（HIST）
information_points.content:
LIA-HIST-SZQ：Per the civic relations schedule for the annual public education program, Palmerston North Secure Repository has an allocated community public open day quota of 4 events planned for public exhibitions in its perimeter atrium.
LIA-HIST-ASP：Under the annual public education program detailed in the civic relations schedule, Upper Hutt Deep Archive Bunker has scheduled a community public open day quota of 2 events for public exhibitions in the repository perimeter atrium.
LIA-HIST-OMH：The civic relations schedule for the annual public education program assigns Trentham Heritage Logistics Center a community public open day quota of 6 events for public exhibitions within the repository perimeter atrium.

information_points.title: Monitors municipal stakeholder sentiment, regional cultural engagement, and civic council endorsements（CIV）
information_points.content:
LIA-CIV-W1N：Based on the civic consultation survey report of host municipality residents and council members, Trentham Heritage Logistics Center recorded a community heritage support index of 58% among surveyed community representatives formally endorsing the hosting of national heritage assets.
LIA-CIV-2TZ：The civic consultation survey report on host municipality resident and council sentiment indicates that Palmerston North Secure Repository achieved a community heritage support index of 91% formal endorsement from surveyed community representatives for hosting national heritage assets.
LIA-CIV-L54：According to the civic consultation survey report assessing host municipality resident and council sentiment, Upper Hutt Deep Archive Bunker achieved a community heritage support index of 74%, representing the proportion of surveyed community representatives expressing formal endorsement for hosting national heritage assets.
